newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TOSHACK SIGNS FOR TURKEY'S BESIKTAS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOSHACK SIGNS FOR TURKEY'S BESIKTAS.

text.p: Britain's John Toshack, who has had a long managerial career in Spain, signed as coach for Turkish club Besiktas on Wednesday.

"I'm pleased by the welcome from the club and the professionalism I have seen so far...I promise not to disappoint the fans," the former Wales and Liverpool striker said after signing the two-year contract.
Toshack resigned as coach of Spanish first division Deportivo Coruna in February after an unsuccessful run in league and cup competitions and clashes with club authorities, players and fans.
He became manager of Real Sociedad in 1985 and had a brief spell at Real Madrid, taking them to the Spanish championship in 1990, before joining Deportivo in 1995.
Besiktas finished runners-up in the Turkish championship last season.
